seed: Prefer the simplest stateless rule set. Treat every object type that never changes in the data as static scenery and model only the types that change.

synth.notes:
Block mode: two cyan 4x4 blocks. ACTION1/2 move both up/down by 4; ACTION3/4 move them apart/together (mirrored). Each block moves on its own and is stopped by the board bounds, a hidden maze of 4x4 cells and marker cells.
ACTION6 on an inactive marker arms it: blocks become color_1 players and the marker turns color_11 active. ACTION1-4 then move only the active marker. Clicking a player returns to block mode; clicking a block or the active marker does nothing; ACTION5 does nothing.
color_0 bars have width floor(3(n+1)/7), where n = actions since the level started. n is hidden state, kept only while the incoming state matches the last returned one; otherwise n = smallest value consistent with the bar. With that tracking off, the score is 17/30.
Names = type_color_rank, sorted by (y,x). block_left/block_right are the exceptions; in block mode they push the other ranks to start at 2.
